span.p:
Cancel ONLY this item
1000-2 cancelled
1000-1 and 1000-3 ship normally

div.style: color: rgb(71, 85, 105) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
This is the core reason for item-level
architecture. Today an OOS item from
one vendor blocks the entire order.
4,110 rows are multi-vendor orders.

reassign vendor_id, keep item_ref
